committee_summary: H.R. 8146, the Police our Borders Act, introduced by Rep. Anthony D'Esposito (R-NY), would require the Attorney General to report to Congress on how the border crisis affects law enforcement at various levels. The report must detail the financial and operational burdens imposed on law enforcement by the crisis, the exposure of officers to dangers like fentanyl, injuries incurred, and overall impact on law enforcement morale.
